# Carbon Border Partnership Strategy
## "One data standard, one carbon-adjusted cost model, four supplier archetypes"

*Note on regulatory state: CBAM's definitive regime, the 2025 simplification package (de minimis threshold, deferred certificate sales, reduced quarterly holding requirement), and the pending scope review (indirect emissions, downstream goods, export treatment) are all in motion. Every number below is a design parameter, not a constant. §8 makes regulatory-watch a standing function rather than a project.*

---

## 1. Diagnose correctly: four dials, not one tariff

The reflex is to treat CBAM as a cost shock to be pushed onto suppliers or absorbed in price. That solves the smallest of four separable problems.

| Dial | What actually varies across suppliers | Wrong response | Right response |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Data & verification** | Metering granularity, installation-level accounting, availability of accredited verifiers, ERP maturity | "Send us your emissions data by Q1" | Buyer-funded MRV build; data is *
